The route uses the full deck of the EU-frames case, which includes every optional run of slides: Part 1 in stage 1, Part 2 and the opening of Part 3 in stage 3, and the rest of Part 3 and Part 4 in stage 4. Each stage page opens the deck at the part that it uses. The deck was written to be presented, so open it in its own tab and press `s` for the speaker view, whose notes give what is said over each slide.

```{=html}
<iframe class="slide-deck" src="../../slides/eu-frames-full.html" title="Slides of the EU-frames case, the full deck"></iframe>
```

Open the deck [in its own tab](../../slides/eu-frames-full.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs of slides on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title.
